title: Iluminacion mejorada con ciclo dia/noche y minimapa tipo radar
request: Dos mejoras pedidas por el usuario, ambas como scripts nuevos e independientes. WorldAtmosphere (servidor) sube la calidad de luz (ShadowMap, sombras globales, exposicion, Atmosphere, Bloom, SunRays y correccion de color) y anade un ciclo dia/noche continuo de 9 minutos reales interpolando amanecer, mediodia, atardecer y noche en Brightness, Ambient, OutdoorAmbient, ColorShift_Top, niebla y densidad atmosferica; enciende las farolas con tag StreetLight de noche. Importante: EventService ya manipula Lighting en los eventos Tormenta y Apagon, asi que el ciclo detecta cambios externos y se aparta 22 s para no pisarlos. Minimap (cliente) anade un radar circular arriba a la derecha que rota con la camara, dibuja los edificios cercanos como rectangulos, y muestra marcas del destino (verde, fijada al borde si queda lejos), ladrones (rojo), vehiculos (amarillo) y otros jugadores (azul), con la tecla M para cambiar el zoom.

operations.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🌤 WORLD ATMOSPHERE · iluminacion + ciclo dia/noche
--
-- Sube la calidad de luz y hace pasar las horas de forma
-- continua (9 min reales = 24 h). De noche enciende las
-- farolas con tag StreetLight.
--
-- EventService tambien toca Lighting (Tormenta, Apagon), asi
-- que si detecta un cambio ajeno cede el control 22 s.
--============================================================
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local CYCLE_MINUTES = 9  -- minutos reales por dia completo
local START_HOUR = 8.5
local STEP = 0.2         -- s entre actualizaciones
local BACKOFF = 22       -- s que cedemos si manda un evento
local NIGHT_ON = 18.2
local NIGHT_OFF = 6.4

local function C(r, g, b)
	return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end

-- claves del ciclo: hora, brillo, ambiente exterior, ambiente,
-- tinte del cielo, niebla, alcance de niebla, densidad, bloom
local KEYS = {
	{ t = 0.0, bright = 0.7, out = C(38, 44, 64), amb = C(20, 22, 32), shift = C(45, 60, 100), fog = C(18, 22, 36), fogEnd = 430, dens = 0.42, bloom = 0.95 },
	{ t = 5.2, bright = 0.9, out = C(70, 66, 88), amb = C(30, 30, 42), shift = C(120, 95, 110), fog = C(80, 78, 100), fogEnd = 480, dens = 0.44, bloom = 1.05 },
	{ t = 6.8, bright = 2.0, out = C(135, 128, 140), amb = C(64, 64, 74), shift = C(255, 185, 135), fog = C(196, 178, 172), fogEnd = 900, dens = 0.35, bloom = 0.8 },
	{ t = 12.0, bright = 2.9, out = C(162, 168, 178), amb = C(88, 92, 98), shift = C(255, 246, 226), fog = C(198, 214, 236), fogEnd = 1500, dens = 0.27, bloom = 0.55 },
	{ t = 16.5, bright = 2.3, out = C(152, 134, 122), amb = C(78, 72, 70), shift = C(255, 190, 130), fog = C(214, 186, 164), fogEnd = 1050, dens = 0.32, bloom = 0.75 },
	{ t = 18.6, bright = 1.1, out = C(96, 78, 92), amb = C(46, 42, 54), shift = C(255, 132, 104), fog = C(148, 108, 118), fogEnd = 600, dens = 0.42, bloom = 1.15 },
	{ t = 20.5, bright = 0.75, out = C(44, 50, 70), amb = C(24, 26, 38), shift = C(60, 78, 124), fog = C(28, 32, 50), fogEnd = 450, dens = 0.44, bloom = 1.0 },
	{ t = 24.0, bright = 0.7, out = C(38, 44, 64), amb = C(20, 22, 32), shift = C(45, 60, 100), fog = C(18, 22, 36), fogEnd = 430, dens = 0.42, bloom = 0.95 },
}

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Calidad base
------------------------------------------------------------
pcall(function()
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.ShadowMap
end)
pcall(function()
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.45
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.35
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.12
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.35
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 9
	Lighting.FogStart = 60
end)

local function ensure(class, name, props)
	local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if inst and inst.ClassName ~= class then
		inst:Destroy()
		inst = nil
	end
	if not inst then
		inst = Instance.new(class)
		inst.Name = name
	end
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		pcall(function()
			inst[key] = value
		end)
	end
	inst.Parent = Lighting
	return inst
end

local atmosphere = ensure("Atmosphere", "Atmosphere", { Density = 0.32, Offset = 0.15, Glare = 0.25, Haze = 1.4, Color = C(199, 199, 199), Decay = C(106, 112, 125) })
local bloom = ensure("BloomEffect", "Bloom", { Intensity = 0.7, Size = 26, Threshold = 1.05 })
ensure("SunRaysEffect", "SunRays", { Intensity = 0.07, Spread = 0.9 })
ensure("ColorCorrectionEffect", "ColorGrade", { Saturation = 0.12, Contrast = 0.08, Brightness = 0, TintColor = C(255, 252, 248) })

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interpolacion del ciclo
------------------------------------------------------------
local function frameAt(t)
	local prev = KEYS[1]
	local nxt = KEYS[#KEYS]
	for i = 1, #KEYS - 1 do
		if t >= KEYS[i].t and t <= KEYS[i + 1].t then
			prev = KEYS[i]
			nxt = KEYS[i + 1]
			break
		end
	end
	local span = nxt.t - prev.t
	local alpha = 0
	if span > 0 then
		alpha = (t - prev.t) / span
	end
	return {
		bright = prev.bright + (nxt.bright - prev.bright) * alpha,
		out = prev.out:Lerp(nxt.out, alpha),
		amb = prev.amb:Lerp(nxt.amb, alpha),
		shift = prev.shift:Lerp(nxt.shift, alpha),
		fog = prev.fog:Lerp(nxt.fog, alpha),
		fogEnd = prev.fogEnd + (nxt.fogEnd - prev.fogEnd) * alpha,
		dens = prev.dens + (nxt.dens - prev.dens) * alpha,
		bloom = prev.bloom + (nxt.bloom - prev.bloom) * alpha,
	}
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ¿Nos ha pisado un evento la iluminacion?
------------------------------------------------------------
local written = nil

local function externalChange()
	if not written then return false end
	if math.abs(Lighting.Brightness - written.bright) > 0.35 then return true end
	if math.abs(Lighting.FogEnd - written.fogEnd) > 70 then return true end
	local a = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
	local b = written.out
	local dist = math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B)
	return dist > 0.2
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Farolas
------------------------------------------------------------
local nightState = nil

local function setStreetLights(on)
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StreetLight")) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			inst.Material = on and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Light") then
					child.Enabled = on
				end
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Light") then
			inst.Enabled = on
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bucle del ciclo
------------------------------------------------------------
local clock = START_HOUR
local suspendUntil = 0

task.spawn(function()
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(STEP)
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - last
		last = now
		clock = (clock + dt * (24 / (CYCLE_MINUTES * 60))) % 24

		if now >= suspendUntil then
			if externalChange() then
				suspendUntil = now + BACKOFF
			else
				local k = frameAt(clock)
				Lighting.ClockTime = clock
				Lighting.Brightness = k.bright
				Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = k.out
				Lighting.Ambient = k.amb
				Lighting.ColorShift_Top = k.shift
				Lighting.FogColor = k.fog
				Lighting.FogEnd = k.fogEnd
				atmosphere.Density = k.dens
				atmosphere.Color = k.fog:Lerp(C(230, 230, 230), 0.5)
				bloom.Intensity = k.bloom
				written = k
			end
		end

		local isNight = clock >= NIGHT_ON or clock <= NIGHT_OFF
		if isNight ~= nightState then
			nightState = isNight
			pcall(setStreetLights, isNight)
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(12)
		if nightState ~= nil then
			pcall(setStreetLights, nightState)
		end
	end
end)

print("[Atmosphere] listo — ciclo dia/noche de " .. CYCLE_MINUTES .. " min")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🗺 MINIMAPA · radar circular arriba a la derecha
--
-- Gira con la camara. Dibuja edificios cercanos y marcas de:
-- destino (verde, pegada al borde si esta lejos), ladrones
-- (rojo), vehiculos (amarillo) y otros jugadores (azul).
-- Tecla M: cambia el zoom.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local SIZE = 190
local ZOOMS = { 150, 260, 420 }
local zoomIndex = 1
local HALF = SIZE / 2

local EXCLUDE do
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	end)
	EXCLUDE = ok and value or Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MinimapGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local map = Instance.new("Frame")
map.Name = "Radar"
map.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE, SIZE)
map.Position = UDim2.new(1, -SIZE - 16, 0, 16)
map.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26)
map.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
map.BorderSizePixel = 0
map.ClipsDescendants = true
map.Parent = gui

local round = Instance.new("UICorner")
round.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
round.Parent = map

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113)
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Transparency = 0.15
stroke.Parent = map

local function ring(fraction)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE * fraction, SIZE * fraction)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.ZIndex = 2
	f.Parent = map
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	c.Parent = f
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 105, 120)
	s.Thickness = 1
	s.Transparency = 0.65
	s.Parent = f
	return f
end
ring(0.36)
ring(0.68)

local function newBlip(size, color, z, circular)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.ZIndex = z
	f.Visible = false
	f.Parent = map
	if circular then
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		c.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

local buildingPool, thiefPool, carPool, peoplePool = {}, {}, {}, {}
for i = 1, 26 do
	buildingPool[i] = newBlip(6, Color3.fromRGB(108, 118, 138), 3, false)
end
for i = 1, 8 do
	thiefPool[i] = newBlip(8, Color3.fromRGB(235, 85, 75), 6, true)
end
for i = 1, 14 do
	carPool[i] = newBlip(7, Color3.fromRGB(250, 205, 90), 5, true)
end
for i = 1, 8 do
	peoplePool[i] = newBlip(7, Color3.fromRGB(95, 165, 245), 5, true)
end

local destBlip = newBlip(11, Color3.fromRGB(90, 235, 140), 7, true)
local destStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
destStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
destStroke.Thickness = 2
destStroke.Parent = destBlip

local north = Instance.new("TextLabel")
north.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
north.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
north.BackgroundTransparency = 1
north.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
north.TextSize = 13
north.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
north.Text = "N"
north.ZIndex = 8
north.Parent = map

local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
arrow.TextSize = 18
arrow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
arrow.Text = "\u{25B2}"
arrow.ZIndex = 9
arrow.Parent = map

local zoomLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
zoomLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
zoomLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -6)
zoomLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 14)
zoomLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
zoomLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
zoomLabel.TextSize = 11
zoomLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 175, 190)
zoomLabel.Text = "M · 150 studs"
zoomLabel.ZIndex = 8
zoomLabel.Parent = map

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Datos del mundo
------------------------------------------------------------
local buildings = {}

local function scanBuildings()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = EXCLUDE
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
	params.MaxParts = 150
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(hrp.Position, ZOOMS[zoomIndex], params)
	local found = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		local size = part.Size
		if part.Anchored and size.Y >= 7 and size.X < 250 and size.Z < 250 then
			local area = size.X * size.Z
			if area >= 45 then
				local owner = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				if not (owner and owner:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
					local _, yaw = part.CFrame:ToOrientation()
					table.insert(found, { pos = part.Position, sx = size.X, sz = size.Z, yaw = yaw, area = area, color = part.Color })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(found, function(a, b)
		return a.area > b.area
	end)
	buildings = found
end

local thiefList, carList, peopleList = {}, {}, {}

local function collect()
	thiefList = {}
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("RigThieves")
	if folder then
		for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			local root = m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				table.insert(thiefList, root)
			end
		end
	end
	local rig = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rig")
	if rig then
		local root = rig.PrimaryPart or rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			table.insert(thiefList, root)
		end
	end

	carList = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, tag in ipairs({ "TrafficCar", "Vehicle" }) do
		for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do
			if not seen[m] and m:IsA("Model") and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				seen[m] = true
				local root = m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
				if root then
					table.insert(carList, root)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	peopleList = {}
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= player then
			local char = other.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				table.insert(peopleList, root)
			end
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Proyeccion mundo → radar
------------------------------------------------------------
local function project(delta, yaw, scale)
	local cos = math.cos(yaw)
	local sin = math.sin(yaw)
	local right = delta.X * cos - delta.Z * sin
	local fwd = -delta.X * sin - delta.Z * cos
	return right * scale, -fwd * scale
end

local function place(frame, x, y)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y)
end

local function drawList(pool, list, origin, yaw, scale)
	local limit = (HALF - 8) * (HALF - 8)
	for i, frame in ipairs(pool) do
		local root = list[i]
		if root and root.Parent then
			local x, y = project(root.Position - origin, yaw, scale)
			if x * x + y * y <= limit then
				frame.Visible = true
				place(frame, x, y)
			else
				frame.Visible = false
			end
		else
			frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then
		zoomIndex = zoomIndex % #ZOOMS + 1
		zoomLabel.Text = "M · " .. ZOOMS[zoomIndex] .. " studs"
		scanBuildings()
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bucle
------------------------------------------------------------
local accBuildings = 1
local accCollect = 1

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		map.Visible = false
		return
	end
	map.Visible = true

	accBuildings = accBuildings + dt
	if accBuildings >= 0.8 then
		accBuildings = 0
		pcall(scanBuildings)
	end
	accCollect = accCollect + dt
	if accCollect >= 0.4 then
		accCollect = 0
		pcall(collect)
	end

	local radius = ZOOMS[zoomIndex]
	local scale = (HALF - 6) / radius
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	local origin = hrp.Position

	for i, frame in ipairs(buildingPool) do
		local b = buildings[i]
		if b then
			local x, y = project(b.pos - origin, yaw, scale)
			if math.abs(x) < HALF + 20 and math.abs(y) < HALF + 20 then
				frame.Visible = true
				frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(b.sx * scale, 3, 90), math.clamp(b.sz * scale, 3, 90))
				frame.Rotation = math.deg(yaw - b.yaw)
				frame.BackgroundColor3 = b.color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(22, 26, 34), 0.45)
				place(frame, x, y)
			else
				frame.Visible = false
			end
		else
			frame.Visible = false
		end
	end

	drawList(carPool, carList, origin, yaw, scale)
	drawList(peoplePool, peopleList, origin, yaw, scale)
	drawList(thiefPool, thiefList, origin, yaw, scale)

	local destPos = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestPos")
	if typeof(destPos) == "Vector3" then
		local x, y = project(destPos - origin, yaw, scale)
		local mag = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
		local limit = HALF - 10
		if mag > limit and mag > 0 then
			x = x / mag * limit
			y = y / mag * limit
		end
		destBlip.Visible = true
		place(destBlip, x, y)
	else
		destBlip.Visible = false
	end

	local nx, ny = project(Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), yaw, HALF - 14)
	place(north, nx, ny)
end)
